readings.summary: Make the generator and analyzer robust to metadata symbols by guarding the unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses so that no exception is thrown, with the closed generic struct from a referenced assembly being processed and a resolver generated.
readings.code_difference: Replaces direct DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] indexing with null-safe FirstOrDefault-style location lookups (falling back to no location) in the diagnostic paths, while still running GetObjectInfo on the closed generic metadata type and generating a formatter for it.
